feeds.title: NewEpicurean
feeds.description: Indulge in the teachings and letters of Epicurus and his Philosophy. Dive deep into the philosophy of Epicurus that was developed for ordinary people, and for far too long it has been hidden away from those who need it most. NewEpicurean is a website that aims to promoting the Study of the Philosophy of Epicurus.

feeds.title: Filosofs » Epicureanism
feeds.description: Michael Lucana in his blog Filosofs touches upon perspective and insights from Epicureanism philosophy. Michael studies and writes about philosophical topics and likes to express his views on Religion and Philosophy, particularly Ancient Greek and Existential Philosophy.

feeds.title: Love of All Wisdom Blog » Epicureanism
feeds.description: Explore our thoughts on Epicureanism in the Love of All Wisdom Blog. This category dissects all aspects of Epicurus's Philosophy and applies it to everyday life. Amod Lele is a researcher in philosophy and through this blog attempts to build a philosophical system that draws, with intellectual integrity, from wisdom from around the world.

feeds.title: Simplestead with Tasha
feeds.description: Simplestead with Tasha is a blog about Simple, Epicurean Homestead Living. Tasha Greer is a writer, working professional, and Epicurean homesteader focused on enjoyable, sustainable living. Here, she shares homesteading choices based on evaluations of what will lead to long-term pleasure while (hopefully) causing minimal harm or even helping the entire planet.

feeds.title: Maverick Philosopher » Epicureanism
feeds.description: Dive into the Maverick Philosopher's entries on Epicureanism. The Maverick Philosopher by Bill Vallicella shares footnotes to Plato from the foothills of the Superstition Mountains. Bill is an academic and has taught philosophy at various universities.
